ICF Publications, Research & Vendor Directory FAQ
This FAQ section from the International Cheese Federation (ICF) addresses common member and non-member inquiries regarding digital publication subscriptions (The Cheesemaker's Journal), advertising opportunities, access to industry research reports like the Cheese Industry Compensation Survey and Global Cheese Market Trends Report, and how to locate packaging suppliers through the member directory. It also provides contact information for member services.

My digital subscription to The Rind didn’t arrive this month. 

 
ICF publishes 
The Cheesemaker’s Journal 
quarterly (not monthly). Issues are distributed electronically in March, June, September, and December. 
 
If you haven’t received the current quarter’s issue, check your spam/junk folder for emails from publications@intlcheese.org, verify your email address is current at members.intlcheese.org, and check the Publications archive at members.intlcheese.org/publications (issues are posted 2–3 days after email distribution). 
 
If you still can’t access the current issue, email 
memberservices@intlcheese.org 
with your membership number. 
 
 
 
 


Advertising in The Cheesemaker’s Journal 

 
The advertising media kit for 
The Cheesemaker’s Journal 
is available at members.intlcheese.org/advertise. 
 

Advertising rates (2026): 


Full page: $2,500 | Half page: $1,500 | Quarter page: $800 | Classified (50 words): $150 
 
Member discount: 15% off all display advertising. Four-issue contracts receive an additional 10% discount. For custom sponsorship packages or questions, contact 
advertising@intlcheese.org 
. 
 
 
 
 


Does ICF publish salary or industry benchmarking reports? 

 
Yes. ICF publishes the 
Cheese Industry Compensation Survey 
biennially (even years). The most recent report (2024) is available to members at members.intlcheese.org/research. 
 
The report includes salary ranges by role (cheesemaker, affineur, QA, sales, etc.), regional compensation variations, benefits and bonus structures, experience level comparisons, and company size correlations. 
 
Non-members can purchase the report for $395 at members.intlcheese.org/shop. 
 
 
 
 


Can I purchase the Global Cheese Trends Report as a non-member? 

 
Yes. The 
Global Cheese Market Trends Report 
is published annually each January. Non-members can purchase for $495 (members receive it free). 
 
The 2026 report includes production trends by category, import/export analysis, consumer preference shifts, emerging cheese styles, regulatory developments, and 5-year market projections. 
 
Purchase at members.intlcheese.org/shop or contact 
memberservices@intlcheese.org 
to request an invoice. 
 
 
 
 


Where can I find the list of approved vendors for packaging supplies? 

 
ICF does not maintain an “approved vendor” list. The online member directory includes supplier companies (corporate members) who provide packaging, equipment, and ingredients to the cheese industry. 
 
Search the directory at members.intlcheese.org/directory with filters for Membership Type (Corporate/Supplier) and Industry Segment (Packaging). The directory provides company contact information, product categories, and website links. ICF does not endorse specific vendors or guarantee product quality.
